# lukax/llms-txt-action

> GitHub Action that generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt for a website, docs or repository using the llms.ink API.

Supports write, commit, pr, check and comment modes, with an optional API key. Commits and pull requests made with the default GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger other workflows.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukax/llms-txt-action/main/README.md)
